name: deterministic-input-equal-byte-for-byte
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): packs/dtn-bpv7/pack.def and pack.md; RFC 9171 4.1 (bundle), 4.3.1 (primary block), 4.3.2 (canonical block), 4.2.1 (CRC); The bundle of vector 01 with a definite outer array (83, which RFC 9171 4.1 allows a receiver to accept): every item already in the core deterministic encoding, so the output equals the input byte for byte. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
